hml.text: Gull the Woodcutter loses his parents and two siblings when White Ridge is destroyed in a wizards' duel, and when Towser asks him to become his freightmaster, Gull, confused by mind magic, accepts and brings his sister Greensleeves.

Towser reveals he will kill Greensleeves to store her power in the mana vault, and teleports Gull away, but Gull returns to fight him, and Greensleeves casts an earthquake and tsunami that sweeps away most of Towser's entourage.
Gull and Greensleeves build an army, and at Lat-Nam Gull realizes the attacking warlord is his lost brother Sparrow Hawk and the brothers reconcile.
Haakon's fireball engulfs the brothers, and Greensleeves goes mad, becomes godlike, but is calmed by Kwam and pours her mana into Lat-Nam, curing it and sacrificing her planeswalker powers.
